english.note: Use 電話 as the all-purpose noun for a phone call, including an attempted call.
Use this as the all-purpose noun for a telephone call.
Use this for a telephone call, rather than for the ringing instrument.
Use this when buzz means a telephone call, especially in expressions meaning “give me a call”; it does not specifically mean an email.

examples.english: I made a call to you just now.
examples.traditional: 我頭先打咗個電話畀你。
examples.jyutping: ngo5 tau4 sin1 daa2 zo2 go3 din6 waa2 bei2 nei5

examples.english: I got a ring from you just now.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 tau4 sin1 sau1 dou2 nei5 go3 din6 waa2

examples.english: I’ll give you a bell in a bit.
examples.jyutping: ngo5 zan6 gaan1 daa2 go3 din6 waa2 bei2 nei5

examples.english: Give me a buzz when you have time.
